facts.text: SUNY Canton features a specialized Pet Wing residence housing option where approved students can live with pets such as cats, rabbits, and ferrets.

sources.title: 2021: SUNY Canton Pet Wing Featured on 'Inside Higher Ed' Website
sources.quote: The Pet Wing currently houses 104 students and 56 pets, which include cats, sugar gliders, hamsters, rabbits, ferrets, fish, rats and mice.
